nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117‑3.3 LDO steps VIN_5V down to VCC_3V3 for the MCU. Input is VIN_5V (global). Output VCC_3V3 is distributed to downstream logic modules.
5V to 3.3V LDO for MCU

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 master controller. Receives VCC_3V3 from power_3v3. Implements SPI master to drive MAX7219 and cascaded shift register. BOOT0 pulled low for Flash boot (not shown).
ARM Cortex-M3 MCU

nodes.name: max7219_driver
nodes.description: MAX7219 LED‑matrix driver powered from VIN_5V. Receives SPI data (DIN, CLK, LOAD) from MCU and drives its segment outputs. DOUT provides serial data to cascade a 74HC595 shift register for additional outputs.
8-digit LED display driver
